recipes.name: Cited Knowledge Extraction
recipes.description: Extracts accurate, grounded answers from private documentation with strict span citations and contradiction abstention.

input_parameters.documents: List of source passage dicts with 'id', 'text', and optional 'timestamp'

output_contract.answer: Grounded answer text with inline citations [1], [2]
output_contract.abstained: Boolean indicating whether query was abstained due to contradictions or lack of evidence

recipes.name: SecOps Incident Triage & Remediation
recipes.description: Analyzes security alerts, determines probable root cause, and generates remediation plans requiring explicit human approval before execution.

input_parameters.incident_id: Unique identifier for alert or ticket
input_parameters.logs: List of log lines or telemetry entries

output_contract.approval_ticket_id: Pending ticket ID awaiting operator approval

recipes.name: Scheduled Operations & Budget Report
recipes.description: Compiles periodic operational metrics, resource utilization, and cost breakdowns, gating external distribution behind human sign-off.

input_parameters.metrics: Dictionary of key performance metrics (runs, latency, spend)

output_contract.approval_ticket_id: Pending approval ticket for external delivery
